findings.title: Findings converge on the stored language tag
findings.why_it_matters: The stored tag draws four findings: no reader, two copies, an awkward home, and overlap with the cache key's filename input.
findings.recommended: B: Keep the stored language tag and address the converging findings individually.
findings.chosen: A: Re-evaluate the stored language tag before addressing the converging findings individually.
findings.choice_reason: honestly i think rework sounds like it may make sense - stored tice + awkward home + overlap all point to something not having been thought out all the way, no?

findings.title: The file loop that replaces SourceFile's route isn't written down
findings.why_it_matters: The design doesn't say who prints the traceback, who builds the load-failure result, where parse_python is called, or which fields LoadedFile holds.
findings.chosen: Add one file-loop bullet to Must hold in the build.

findings.title: Language, the suffix table, and the stored tag ship ahead of any reader
findings.why_it_matters: The diff adds a language model nothing reads; a record without the field keeps the invariant removal.
findings.recommended: A: Keep the Language enum, the suffix table, and the language field as ratified in D3.

findings.title: LoadedFile.language is a second stored copy of the tag
findings.why_it_matters: The tag lives on DiscoveredFile, is copied to LoadedFile, and can be derived.
findings.recommended: A: Keep language on LoadedFile as D3 says.

findings.title: The language model's home in source.py puts a domain concept in the loader
findings.why_it_matters: A reader starting from discovery finds the suffix table in the loader.
findings.recommended: C: Put it in a new leaf module, language.py, imported by discovery and the loader, and by the catalog in #59.

findings.title: The cache key still derives language from the filename while the tag is now stored
findings.why_it_matters: The key's correctness depends on language_for staying a pure function of the path, and that rule sits away from it.
findings.recommended: B: Keep filename as the key input, and state on language_for that a non-path input must join hash_effective_config.

findings.title: One failure type serves two layers with opposite cache policy
findings.why_it_matters: Nothing on the value says which cache policy applies, so a reader learns it from the loop's order.
findings.recommended: A: Keep one failure type, and state in D2 that a cache key needs a LoadedFile, so a load failure can't get one.
findings.chosen: B: Use two failure types, LoadFailure and ParseFailure.

findings.title: Renaming SourceFile to PythonSource has no reader until #61
findings.why_it_matters: The new name only disambiguates from a TypeScript sibling that doesn't exist yet.
findings.recommended: A: Keep PythonSource and python_source.py as ratified in D4.
findings.chosen: A: Keep PythonSource and python_source.py as ratified in D4.

findings.title: Nothing owns the language-to-analysis dispatch
Findings converge on open_source turning load outcomes into a FileScanResult
findings.why_it_matters: Three critics reached one conversion point, and answers to the individual findings interact.
findings.choice_reason: Re-evaluation chose open_source returning LoadedFile | LoadFailure | FileScanResult, with the result meaning abort only.

findings.title: One return type carries both skip this file and abort the run, told apart by a boolean
findings.why_it_matters: Only the stop literal separated continuing from ending the run.
findings.recommended: B: Have open_source return LoadedFile | LoadFailure | FileScanResult, where the result means abort only, and have the loop handle LoadFailure in its own arm.

findings.title: The cache rule is carried by call-site position, and --debug replay infers a parse failure from cached.errors
findings.why_it_matters: Load and parse failures looked identical after conversion.

findings.title: LoadFailure and ParseFailure don't have the identical fields the ledger says they have
findings.why_it_matters: The ledger's wording was inaccurate, and the shared helper's None check can't be false for one input.
findings.recommended: B: Keep the two shapes as they are and correct identical fields in D2's ratification sentence.

findings.title: The ledger's internal-error label claim is wrong about the old code, and JSON output differs for one reproducible input
findings.why_it_matters: The ledger recorded a label change as no change.
findings.chosen: Record the source-analyze relabel in Calls made, and change the labels stay to the labels are in Must hold.

findings.title: The never cache an oversized file rule moved from a check to an unstated invariant
findings.why_it_matters: Nothing stated that the cache relies on load_file's size bound.
findings.recommended: A: Add a sentence to LoadedFile's docstring stating the size bound and that load_file establishes it.
findings.chosen: A: Add a sentence to LoadedFile's docstring stating the size bound and that load_file establishes it.

findings.title: Language has no reader, so language_for isn't yet the one place language is decided
findings.why_it_matters: A table-only .ts edit would parse TypeScript as Python with no failing check.
findings.recommended: B: Keep the model as ratified, correct D3's Unread names cell to name Language.PYTHON, and note the scan_source, error-message, and hook pickups for #61.
findings.chosen: B: Keep the model as ratified, correct D3's Unread names cell to name Language.PYTHON, and note the scan_source, error-message, and hook pickups for #61.

findings.title: Rule tests use a two-step helper recipe across two files
findings.why_it_matters: Rule-test authors learn two helpers for one recipe.
findings.recommended: A: Add a parse_sample fixture returning a PythonSource, use it in rule tests, and update CLAUDE.md.
findings.chosen: A: Add a parse_sample fixture returning a PythonSource, use it in rule tests, and update CLAUDE.md.

findings.title: A file's encoding declaration can abort the whole run with an internal error (on master too)
findings.why_it_matters: An uncaught UnicodeError becomes an internal error that ends the run.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation: a .py file declaring a codec like undefined aborts the run with an internal error, as it does today.
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation: a .py file declaring a codec like undefined aborts the run with an internal error, as it does today.

findings.title: Pipeline tests pin never cached for read errors and oversize, but not path escape or non-regular files
findings.why_it_matters: A later edit splitting the shared branch could lose the guarantee for two kinds without a failing test.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation: path-escape and non-regular load failures are pinned at unit level only, and share one pipeline branch with the two pinned kinds.
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation: path-escape and non-regular load failures are pinned at unit level only, and share one pipeline branch with the two pinned kinds.
